systems.system: Digital tool for collecting teaching-staff data
systems.country_label: outil numérique de collecte des données du personnel enseignant (Portail de l'Éducation du Mali)
systems.owner: Ministère de l'Éducation nationale, under the PADEM project
systems.tiers: Académies d'Enseignement (CDCAF, statistics and planning adviser, personnel officer, IT officer) and Centres d'Animation Pédagogique (guidance counsellors), trained 23-30 March 2026 at Kayes, Koulikoro, Sikasso and Bamako

note: No fact: the tool updates and centralises teacher records only (names, service numbers, status, corps, posts), keyed at academy and CAP level, so it is single-function. The article says PADEM also aims at digital tracking of pupils' school attendance, but describes no system for it.
